blocker.mechanism: The write lock is retained across external result object write, relational registration, progress publication and compensation. A durable terminal UPDATE on that row waits for the transaction to finish. Current one-thread fixed-delay dispatch/cleanup does not independently establish a maximum inspection delay either. GenAI budgets do not bound this result-finalization transaction.
blocker.cutoffInterleaving: Finalization starts just before accepted+480s and holds the row lock while storage is delayed. A competing deadline UPDATE waits; merely adding an age predicate or scheduler does not release this existing lock or establish finite durable commit delay.
blocker.scopeInterpretation: This is an identified finalization/DB lock boundary expressly named in section 7 of the USER resume request. It is not a live GCS outage diagnosis or a demand for broad network hardening.
blocker.whyNotSilentlyChange: Moving external write/compensation outside the transaction requires choosing new finalization ownership, recheck, cleanup and publication sequencing. The USER explicitly prohibits silently redesigning finalization if this boundary prevents proving delta.
blocker.scopeDecisionNeeded: Authorize a narrowly specified finalization/terminal-fencing correction and deterministic failure/cleanup validation on this same PR, or supply an independently defensible finalization bound. No future architecture option is selected here.
